STAGEHAND.Outdated: Stagehand: this world's queued changes were left by a newer version of Stagehand. Update the companion module to apply them.

Apply.Title: Stagehand: apply module changes
Apply.Intro: Changes queued from the Setup screen for this world. Applying reloads the world once.
Apply.NoChange: No change: the world already matches.
Apply.Dependents: Still needed by modules that stay
Apply.AcceptConflicts: Enable these modules despite the declared conflicts
Apply.RemoveDependents: Also disable the modules that need a removed one
Apply.Reviewed: Stagehand: applying the module changes you reviewed on the Setup screen. The world reloads once.
Apply.NeedConflictConsent: Stagehand: confirm the conflicts to apply, or choose Not now.
Apply.NeedDependentsChoice: Stagehand: choose to disable the dependent modules too, or choose Not now.
Apply.Unsaved: Stagehand: nothing was changed, because the result couldn't be saved in the world. The changes stay queued.

STAGEHAND.BadQueue: Stagehand: this world's queued changes couldn't be read, so none were applied. Queue them again on the Setup screen.

Manage.SettingHint: Modules appear as cards in the library's folders, with each module's details, presets and a review before saving. Turn this off for Foundry's own list, for example if another module adds to that window. This applies to you only.
Manage.SettingHintBbmm: Modules appear as cards in the library's folders, with each module's details, presets and a review before saving. Turn this off for Foundry's own list, for example if another module adds to that window. This applies to you only. In this world BBMM opens its own window from the button: Shift-click Module Management for this view.
Manage.Intro: Saving changes this world's modules and reloads the world once.
Manage.NoChange: Nothing to save: the world already matches.
Manage.Blocked: Can't turn on: missing or incompatible requirements
Manage.Dependents: Still needed by modules that stay
Manage.AcceptConflicts: Turn these modules on despite the declared conflicts
Manage.RemoveDependents: Also turn off the modules that need a removed one
Manage.NeedConflictConsent: Stagehand: confirm the conflicts to save, or go back.
Manage.NeedDependentsChoice: Stagehand: choose to turn off the modules that need it too, or go back.
Manage.SaveFailed: Stagehand: the modules couldn't be saved ({error}). Nothing was changed.
Manage.PickHint: Presets from this server's Stagehand library. Their changes show on the cards; Save Module Settings applies them.
Manage.NoPresets: The library has no presets yet. Make them on the Setup screen.
Manage.ModeAddHint: Turn these modules on. Everything else stays as it is.
Manage.ModeReplaceHint: This world gets exactly these modules. Stagehand stays on.
Manage.ModeRemoveHint: Turn these modules off. Everything else stays as it is.
Manage.ActiveHint: All its modules are on in this world
Manage.Skipped: Stagehand: not installed on this server, so skipped: {modules}.
Manage.BbmmIntro: BBMM and Stagehand each have their own Module Management view. Which one should Module Management open in this world?
Manage.BbmmUseHint: Turns off BBMM's “Enable enhanced module management” for everyone in this world and reloads it. BBMM's other tools stay, and so does its toolbox button in the window.
Manage.BbmmKeepHint: Nothing changes. Shift-click Module Management to open Stagehand's view.
Manage.BbmmLater: You can change this later in Configure Settings: BBMM's “Enable enhanced module management”, or Stagehand's “Library view in Module Management”.
Manage.BbmmUsed: Stagehand: BBMM's enhanced module management is off. Module Management opens Stagehand's view.
Manage.BbmmKept: Stagehand: BBMM's view stays. Shift-click Module Management to open Stagehand's view.
Manage.ViewFailed: Stagehand: the library view couldn't load, so Module Management shows Foundry's own list.
